items.title: Brian Heder's Sunken Smuggler Crate
items.description: Community confirmed coordinate for Brian Heder's emergency contraband drop tied to the sunken buoy 300m off Key Largo reef.
items.tips: Watch for hammerhead sharks near the yellow marker buoy.

items.title: Vice Commercial Vault Intake Flue
items.payout: Direct Vault Entry Route (Bypasses Lobby CCTV)
items.description: Secondary ventilation shaft discovered beneath 5th Street stormwater interceptor. Allows gas grenade drop into guard room.
items.tips: Requires standard crowbar to pry rusted exhaust grate.

items.title: Ancient Skunk Ape Totem Tree Carvings
items.payout: Lore Audio Log + Secret Shaman Mask
items.description: Trio of ancient cypress trunks carved with primal primate symbols and glowing moss in the central Grassrivers marsh.
items.tips: Emits distinct low frequency rumble during heavy rainfall.

items.title: Container Crane Master Override Console
items.payout: Drops Container Wall Blocking Police Chokepoint
items.description: Auxiliary terminal on Crane 04 allowing operators to drop a 40-foot shipping container directly onto the main port exit gate during escapes.
items.tips: Use EMP hack tool for instant 5-second override.

items.title: Mount Kalaga Abandoned Radio Repeater 09
items.description: Decommissioned radio relay mast perched on western Kalaga cliff. Tapping solar battery intercepts high-speed highway patrol chatter.
items.tips: Bypass battery circuit using copper wire jumper.

items.title: Abandoned Citrus Packing Floorboard Safe
items.description: Decaying wooden packing shed south of Ambrosia with false floorboards concealing an old iron combination strongbox.
items.tips: Combination (44-12-86) is scratched into the window frame.
